title: Declared retry regressions lacked executable test file in checkpoint
observation: The v0.09.2 checkpoint declared REG-0020, REG-0021, and REG-0022 automated and named tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py, but that referenced test file was absent.
root_cause: Retry governance records were preregistered before the concrete regression test module and reusable fail-closed freeze helper were materialized in the checkpoint.
disposition: Resolved before freeze by adding the referenced automated regressions and a generic fail-closed contract finalization/write helper, then rerunning all prefreeze checks. No frozen artifact existed at discovery time.
